notes.title: A workaround for Final Fantasy VII Rebirth on Linux with NVIDIA GPUs has been found
notes.notes:
While Final Fantasy VII Rebirth can work on Linux with AMD GPUs (like Steam Deck), the situation with NVIDIA GPUs has been messy. Open source to the rescue though, again.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/02/a-workaround-for-final-fantasy-vii-rebirth-on-linux-with-nvidia-gpus-has-been-found/

notes.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH gets stability fixes and a Steam Deck graphics setting tweak
notes.notes:
FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH has its first post-release patch to improve how it runs across all systems, with some useful improvements.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/02/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth-gets-stability-fixes-and-a-steam-deck-graphics-setting-tweak/

notes.title: Version 1.001 Release Notice
notes.notes:
[Updates]
[list]
[*]  Improved overall game stability, including several bug fixes.
[*]  Fixed the graphics preset to be set to 'Low' when launching for the first time on Steam Deck, even when save data is linked from the cloud. (The next time the game is launched on Steam Deck, the saved settings will be applied.)
[*]  When playing on a PC that supports NVIDIA DLSS, the default setting for 'Anti-Aliasing Method' is now set to 'DLSS'.
[*]  The DirectStorage DLL (Dynamic Link Library) has been updated to the latest version.
[/list]

notes.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH released today!
notes.notes:
The FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE project brings FINAL FANTASY VII, the legendary RPG that enthralled the world, back to life using the latest technology.  

The first game in the series, FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE was released in 2020 and received critical acclaim across the world, achieving global sales of over 7,000,000 copies (as of May 2023).

Now, the core of the FINAL FANTASY VII story returns with the second game in the trilogy: FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH! 

Early purchase sale running until 05/02/2025!
Twin pack also available for 30% off! 
Why not take this chance to own both FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE and FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH for around the cost of just a single game?!

Watch the FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH live broadcast on Twitch to obtain the in-game items Kupo Charm and Survival Set!

An accessory that increases the amount of crafting materials extracted by a set rate.

notes.title: How to access the Square Enix Digital Content Viewer
notes.notes:
The digital art book and digital mini-soundtrack (henceforth referred to as “this content”) included in the FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH Digital Deluxe Edition, the FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE & REBIRTH Digital Deluxe Twin Pack and the FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH Digital Deluxe Edition Upgrade can be viewed using the Square Enix Digital Content Viewer.
*The Square Enix Digital Content Viewer is a digital content viewing service provided by Square Enix. It can be used to view digital content from Square Enix products, such as digital art books and digital soundtracks.

The Square Enix Digital Content Viewer can be used on a PC web browser. It can be accessed from the URL below.
[url=https://d-viewer.square-enix.com/]https://d-viewer.square-enix.com/[/url]

It is also possible to access the viewer using the following steps.
[olist]
[*]  Right click on FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH in your Steam library and select “Properties”.
[*]  In the “Properties” window, open “Installed files” tab and click on “Browse”.
[*]  Run the “SQEXDigitalContentViewer.bat” file found in the “OSTAndArtBook” folder.
[/olist]
*Logging on to the platform account that the content was purchased on is required In order to view it.
*Data transmission costs incurred when using this service are to be borne by the customer. 

■Languages supported by the Square Enix Digital Content Viewer
・Interface: Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and Korean

■Languages supported by the digital art book and digital mini-soundtrack
・Interface: Japanese, English

notes.title: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth (PC) Review
notes.notes:
When Final Fantasy VII Rebirth hit PlayStation 5 last year, it took the world by storm. Not only that, but it also took CGM by storm. For the PS5 review, we had this to say: “Final Fantasy VII Rebirth delivers upon Remake’s thesis, increasing a classic’s scale and character tenfold to create a new modern-day masterpiece.” Read that review here.

Much like our original review, this will be a spoiler-free review as most of the magic within Final Fantasy VII Rebirth is the plot.

With Final Fantasy VII Remake already under its belt, Square Enix set itself up for an incredible challenge in crafting Rebirth. But instead of simply rehashing the events of the original, Rebirth builds upon its predecessor in exciting ways. The result is a game that respects the history of its forbearer while simultaneously offering a fresh and thrilling experience for both old die-hard fans and newcomers alike.

notes.title: Be ready for FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH on PC
notes.notes:
Just announced! 
FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH is set for a Steam launch on January 23, 2025.

[previewyoutube=9608h47LoWg;full][/previewyoutube]

This version introduces new features and customizations to take full advantage of the PC platform: 

[h3]LIGHTING[/h3]
Lighting has been adjusted, and the game's overall rendering of light is significantly improved. The updated areas and cutscenes present with even greater beauty and clarity than before.

[h3]PC SPECS[/h3]
The PC version of FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH features three default graphics presets to make it even easier for you to jump in and start playing at a level that suits your own PC: High, Medium and Low. We have optimised these presets to allow as many people to enjoy the game as possible on a wide variety of setups.
Gameplay offers an experience that will feel new, including high frame rates of up to 120 FPS.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45155195/a7bbf3b8b95c15459026714ba9d0c96c03044d1e.jpg[/img]
[h3]FRAMERATE AND RESOLUTION[/h3]
NVIDIA DLSS support means that frame rates can be enhanced and image quality upscaled. There is now also support for variable refresh rate (VRR).

[h3]TEXTURES[/h3]
The Level of Detail (LoD) for background models and MIP maps for background textures can both be freely configured in the options settings.
With this background polygon density and texture density can be set higher than was previously possible, allowing for gameplay with higher-quality graphics.

[h3]CONTROLLER INPUT SUPPORT[/h3]
Connecting a DualSense® controller with a PC allows players to use the same controls as the PS5 version.
Keyboard and mouse support has also been added, alongside the option to freely customize the controls between world exploration and combat or mini-games.

[h3]STEAM DECK[/h3]
We are also working diligently on optimisations to make sure that the Steam version is playable on Steam Deck as well.

Pre-purchase to receive a 30% Early Bird Discount* and three digital bonus items**: 'Moogle Trio' summoning materia, Midgar Bangle Mk. II Armor, Shinra bangle Mk. II.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2909400/

* Offer applies to select versions of the game. Up to 30% off digital pre-orders until 5 February 2025. Certain restrictions may apply.
** These bonus items can be obtained by pre-purchasing the game before 13:59 on Thursday 23/01/2025 (GMT).
** Digital content items may be put on sale separately at a later date.

For the latest updates on FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH, make sure you follow us on Twitter, Instagram, and Facebook!

Thank you for your support!
